blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks rallied on Friday as investors hunted for bargains, with lower global bond yields and oil prices supporting sentiment. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) gained 119.53 points, or 2.11 percent, to close at 5,782.70. READ: Gasoline rollback, slight diesel hike seen next week Philstocks Financial Inc. said the decline in global bond yields, led by United States treasury yields, and the pullback in global oil prices helped drive buying. Foreign investors also supported the advance, posting net inflows of P148.21 million. Trading remained tepid, however, with net value turnover reaching P5.26 billion.
